import pandas as pd

# Load the catalogs
series_catalog = pd.read_csv(CATALOG_CSV)
graph_data = pd.read_json(GRAPH_TTL)

# Extract series ids from the graph results
zone_id = graph_data.iloc[0]['zone_ref'].split('/')[-1]
heating_setpoint_id = graph_data.iloc[0]['heating_setpoint_ref'].split('/')[-1]
cooling_setpoint_id = graph_data.iloc[0]['cooling_setpoint_ref'].split('/')[-1]

# Filter CATALOG_CSV for the required time-series
zone_series = series_catalog[series_catalog['point_uri'].str.contains(zone_id)]
heating_setpoint_series = series_catalog[series_catalog['point_uri'].str.contains(heating_setpoint_id)]
cooling_setpoint_series = series_catalog[series_catalog['point_uri'].str.contains(cooling_setpoint_id)]

# Load the time-series data for each
zone_values = pd.read_csv(VALUES_CSV, usecols=['timeseries_id'] + [str(i) for i in range(1, 25)])
heating_setpoint_values = pd.read_csv(VALUES_CSV, usecols=['timeseries_id'] + [str(i) for i in range(1, 25)])
cooling_setpoint_values = pd.read_csv(VALUES_CSV, usecols=['timeseries_id'] + [str(i) for i in range(1, 25)])

# Join time-series data based on the time-series ID
zone_values = zone_values[zone_values['timeseries_id'].isin(zone_series['timeseries_id'])]
heating_setpoint_values = heating_setpoint_values[heating_setpoint_values['timeseries_id'].isin(heating_setpoint_series['timeseries_id'])]
cooling_setpoint_values = cooling_setpoint_values[cooling_setpoint_values['timeseries_id'].isin(cooling_setpoint_series['timeseries_id'])]

# Convert columns 1-24 to numeric
zone_values.iloc[:, 1:] = zone_values.iloc[:, 1:].apply(pd.to_numeric)
heating_setpoint_values.iloc[:, 1:] = heating_setpoint_values.iloc[:, 1:].apply(pd.to_numeric)
cooling_setpoint_values.iloc[:, 1:] = cooling_setpoint_values.iloc[:, 1:].apply(pd.to_numeric)

# Sum the number of values outside the setpoint band
outside_band_count = ((zone_values.iloc[:, 1:] < heating_setpoint_values.iloc[:, 1:].values) | (zone_values.iloc[:, 1:] > cooling_setpoint_values.iloc[:, 1:].values)).sum(axis=1).sum()

print(outside_band_count)
